title: Emergent Persuasion: Will LLMs Persuade Without Being Prompted?
reasoning: The paper investigates the propensity of LLMs to engage in unprompted persuasion on harmful and controversial topics. While its evaluation dataset includes topics that carry moral or ethical weight (e.g., kidnapping, abortion), the study focuses on the mechanics of persuasion and safety misalignment rather than evaluating religious beliefs or formal ethical reasoning frameworks.
